name: Fitness Tracker
highLevelGoals: Enable users to accurately record and monitor their various physical activities to maintain a comprehensive log of their exercise habits.
Provide users with clear and insightful visualizations of their fitness data to help them understand their improvements and consistency over time.
Allow users to define, manage, and track their personal fitness objectives to provide motivation and direction for their fitness journey.
Deliver tailored workout recommendations and plans that adapt to the user's fitness level, preferences, and progress to optimize their training effectiveness.
Enable users to share their fitness activities and milestones on social media to foster engagement, celebrate progress, and motivate their network.
Supply the fitness application with real-time and historical physical activity data to ensure comprehensive and accurate user tracking.
Ensure smooth and reliable connectivity with the fitness application for automatic data synchronization and an uninterrupted user experience.
lowLevelGoals: Initiate the recording of a new physical activity session, capturing start time and activity type.
Conclude the recording of the current physical activity session, capturing end time and duration.
Manually input details of a physical activity that was not automatically tracked, including activity type, duration, and estimated calories burned.
Retrieve and display a list of all previously recorded physical activities.
Display comprehensive metrics for a selected physical activity, such as distance, pace, heart rate, and calories burned.
Generate and present graphical representations of fitness data over specified time periods (e.g., weekly, monthly, yearly).
Allow users to select and compare performance metrics between different activity sessions or against personal bests.
Create and display summary reports of fitness achievements and trends for a selected period.
Define a new fitness goal, specifying type (e.g., weight loss, distance, duration), target value, and deadline.
Modify the parameters of an existing fitness goal, such as target value or deadline.
Display the current progress towards a specific fitness goal, showing remaining target and time.
Send an alert to the user when a fitness goal has been successfully achieved.
Create a personalized workout plan based on user's fitness level, goals, and preferred activity types.
Modify an existing workout plan based on user feedback, progress, or changes in fitness level.
Present detailed instructions and demonstrations for exercises within a personalized workout plan.
Suggest the next workout session or activity based on the user's schedule and plan progression.
Post details of a completed physical activity (e.g., distance, duration, route map) to a selected social media platform.
Post a notification of a achieved fitness goal to a selected social media platform.
Allow users to select which data points and accompanying text are included when sharing an achievement.
Send continuous streams of sensor data (e.g., heart rate, steps, GPS coordinates) to the fitness application during an active session.
Upload stored activity logs and summary data from the device to the fitness application.
Communicate device status information (e.g., battery level, connection status) to the fitness application.
Initiate and maintain a stable Bluetooth connection with the fitness application for data exchange.
Perform automatic data synchronization with the fitness application at regular intervals or upon connection.
Manage temporary disconnections and re-establish connection with the fitness application without data loss.
